formulas.name: APIFirstListingDate_Formula
formulas.expression: IF(NULLVALUE({!ToCombine_ListingContractDate},{!ToCombine_OnMarketDate})<NULLVALUE({!ToCombine_OnMarketDate},{!ToCombine_ListingContractDate}),NULLVALUE({!ToCombine_ListingContractDate},{!ToCombine_OnMarketDate}),NULLVALUE({!ToCombine_OnMarketDate},{!ToCombine_ListingContractDate}))

formulas.name: APIHistoricalTransactionTotalValue
formulas.expression: {!APIHistoricalTransactionCount}*{!APIAverageClosingPrice}

formulas.name: APILeadEnrichmentDataDate
formulas.expression: {!$Record.CreatedDate}

formulas.name: AverageClosingPrice_FilterFormula
formulas.expression: "(BuyerAgentKey eq '"+{!APIMemberKey}+"' or ListAgentKey eq '"+{!APIMemberKey}+"' or CoListAgentKey eq '"+{!APIMemberKey}+"' or CoBuyerAgentKey eq '"+{!APIMemberKey}+"') and StandardStatus eq 'Closed' and org.reso.metadata.enums.PropertyType ne 'Residential Lease' and org.reso.metadata.enums.PropertyType ne 'Commercial Lease' and DerivedCloseDate le " + {!LeadCreatedDate}

formulas.name: AverageListingPrice_FilterFormula
formulas.expression: "(ListAgentKey eq '"+{!APIMemberKey}+"' or CoListAgentKey eq '"+{!APIMemberKey}+"') and org.reso.metadata.enums.PropertyType ne 'Residential Lease' and org.reso.metadata.enums.PropertyType ne 'Commercial Lease' and ListingContractDate le " +{!LeadCreatedDate}

formulas.name: AVGMarketPrice_FilterFormula
formulas.expression: "StandardStatus eq 'Closed' and org.reso.metadata.enums.PropertyType eq 'Residential' and City eq '" + SUBSTITUTE({!APIMemberCity}, "'", "''") + "' and StateOrProvince eq '"+{!APIMemberStateOrProvince}+"' and DerivedCloseDate gt " +TEXT(ADDMONTHS(DATEVALUE({!$Record.CreatedDate}),-12))

formulas.name: CombinedFirstLeaseListingDate
formulas.expression: NULLVALUE({!Historical_Lease_Count_Loop.ListingContractDate},{!Historical_Lease_Count_Loop.OnMarketDate})

formulas.name: CurrentListingCount_FilterFormula
formulas.expression: "(ListAgentKey eq '" + {!APIMemberKey} + "' or CoListAgentKey eq '"+{!APIMemberKey}+"') and org.reso.metadata.enums.PropertyType ne 'Residential Lease' and org.reso.metadata.enums.PropertyType ne 'Commercial Lease' and (ListingContractDate le "+{!LeadCreatedDate} + " and OffMarketDate ge "+ {!LeadCreatedDate}+")"

formulas.name: FirstListingDate_FilterFormula
formulas.expression: "(ListAgentKey eq '"+{!APIMemberKey} + "' or CoListAgentKey eq '"+{!APIMemberKey}+"') and org.reso.metadata.enums.PropertyType ne 'Residential Lease' and org.reso.metadata.enums.PropertyType ne 'Commercial Lease' and ListingContractDate le " +{!LeadCreatedDate}

formulas.name: FirstTransactionDate_FilterFormula
formulas.expression: "(BuyerAgentKey eq '"+{!APIMemberKey}+"' or ListAgentKey eq '"+{!APIMemberKey}+"' or CoListAgentKey eq '"+{!APIMemberKey}+"' or CoBuyerAgentKey eq '"+{!APIMemberKey}+"') and StandardStatus eq 'Closed' and org.reso.metadata.enums.PropertyType ne 'Residential Lease' and org.reso.metadata.enums.PropertyType ne 'Commercial Lease' and DerivedCloseDate le " + {!LeadCreatedDate}

formulas.name: FormattedPhone_NumbersOnly_RemoveCountryCode
formulas.expression: IF(OR(CONTAINS({!FormattedPhone_RemoveCountryCode},"-"),CONTAINS({!FormattedPhone_RemoveCountryCode},"(")),SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE({!FormattedPhone_RemoveCountryCode},"-",""),"(",""),")","")," ",""),{!FormattedPhone_RemoveCountryCode})

formulas.name: FormattedPhone_RemoveCountryCode
formulas.expression: IF(LEFT(SUBSTITUTE({!$Record.Phone},"+",""),1)="1",RIGHT(SUBSTITUTE({!$Record.Phone},"+",""),LEN(SUBSTITUTE({!$Record.Phone},"+",""))-1),SUBSTITUTE({!$Record.Phone},"+",""))

formulas.name: HistoricalLeaseCount_FilterFormula
formulas.expression: "(BuyerAgentKey eq '"+{!APIMemberKey}+"' or ListAgentKey eq '"+{!APIMemberKey}+"' or CoListAgentKey eq '"+{!APIMemberKey}+"' or CoBuyerAgentKey eq '"+{!APIMemberKey}+"') and StandardStatus eq 'Closed' and (org.reso.metadata.enums.PropertyType eq 'Residential Lease' or org.reso.metadata.enums.PropertyType eq 'Commercial Lease') and OnMarketDate le " + {!LeadCreatedDate}

formulas.name: HistoricalTransactionCount_FilterFormula
formulas.expression: "(BuyerAgentKey eq '"+{!APIMemberKey}+"' or ListAgentKey eq '"+{!APIMemberKey}+"' or CoListAgentKey eq '"+{!APIMemberKey}+"' or CoBuyerAgentKey eq '"+{!APIMemberKey}+"') and StandardStatus eq 'Closed' and org.reso.metadata.enums.PropertyType ne 'Residential Lease' and org.reso.metadata.enums.PropertyType ne 'Commercial Lease' and ListingContractDate le " +{!LeadCreatedDate} + " and DerivedCloseDate le " +{!LeadCreatedDate}

formulas.name: LatestListingDate_FilterFormula
formulas.expression: "(ListAgentKey eq '"+ {!APIMemberKey} + "' or CoListAgentKey eq '"+{!APIMemberKey}+"') and org.reso.metadata.enums.PropertyType ne 'Residential Lease' and org.reso.metadata.enums.PropertyType ne 'Commercial Lease' and ListingContractDate le " + {!LeadCreatedDate}

formulas.name: LatestTransactionDate_FilterFormula
formulas.expression: "(BuyerAgentKey eq '"+{!APIMemberKey}+"' or ListAgentKey eq '"+{!APIMemberKey}+"' or CoListAgentKey eq '"+{!APIMemberKey}+"' or CoBuyerAgentKey eq '"+{!APIMemberKey}+"') and StandardStatus eq 'Closed' and org.reso.metadata.enums.PropertyType ne 'Residential Lease' and org.reso.metadata.enums.PropertyType ne 'Commercial Lease' and DerivedCloseDate le " + {!LeadCreatedDate}

formulas.name: LeadCreatedDate
formulas.expression: TEXT(DATEVALUE({!$Record.CreatedDate}))

formulas.name: ListingCountLast12Months_FilterFormula
formulas.expression: "(ListAgentKey eq '"+{!APIMemberKey} + "' or CoListAgentKey eq '"+{!APIMemberKey}+"') and ListingContractDate ge " + TEXT(ADDMONTHS(DATEVALUE({!$Record.CreatedDate}),-12)) + " and ListingContractDate le " + {!LeadCreatedDate} + " and org.reso.metadata.enums.PropertyType ne 'Residential Lease' and org.reso.metadata.enums.PropertyType ne 'Commercial Lease'"

formulas.name: ListingCountLast6Months_FilterFormula
formulas.expression: "(ListAgentKey eq '"+{!APIMemberKey} + "' or CoListAgentKey eq '"+{!APIMemberKey}+"') and ListingContractDate ge " + TEXT(ADDMONTHS(DATEVALUE({!$Record.CreatedDate}),-6)) + " and ListingContractDate le " + {!LeadCreatedDate} + " and org.reso.metadata.enums.PropertyType ne 'Residential Lease' and org.reso.metadata.enums.PropertyType ne 'Commercial Lease'"

formulas.name: MemberFilterFormula_Email
formulas.expression: "MemberEmail eq '"+{!$Record.Email}+"'or (MemberFullName eq '"+SUBSTITUTE({!$Record.FirstName}, "'", "''")+" "+SUBSTITUTE({!$Record.LastName}, "'", "''")+"' and startswith(MemberDirectPhone,'"+LEFT({!FormattedPhone_RemoveCountryCode},3)+"')) or (MemberFullName eq '"+SUBSTITUTE({!$Record.FirstName}, "'", "''")+" "+SUBSTITUTE({!$Record.LastName}, "'", "''")+"' and startswith(MemberMobilePhone,'"+LEFT({!FormattedPhone_RemoveCountryCode},3)+"')) or (MemberFullName eq '"+SUBSTITUTE({!$Record.FirstName}, "'", "''")+" "+SUBSTITUTE({!$Record.LastName}, "'", "''")+"' and startswith(MemberHomePhone,'"+LEFT({!FormattedPhone_RemoveCountryCode},3)+"')) or (MemberLastName eq '"+SUBSTITUTE({!$Record.LastName}, "'", "''")+"' and startswith(MemberDirectPhone,'"+LEFT({!FormattedPhone_NumbersOnly_RemoveCountryCode},7)+"')) or (MemberLastName eq '"+SUBSTITUTE({!$Record.LastName}, "'", "''")+"' and startswith(MemberMobilePhone,'"+LEFT({!FormattedPhone_NumbersOnly_RemoveCountryCode},7)+"')) or (MemberLastName eq '"+SUBSTITUTE({!$Record.LastName}, "'", "''")+"' and startswith(MemberHomePhone,'"+LEFT({!FormattedPhone_NumbersOnly_RemoveCountryCode},7)+"'))"

formulas.name: MemberFilterFormula_NoEmail
formulas.expression: "(MemberFullName eq '"+{!$Record.FirstName}+" "+{!$Record.LastName}+"' and startswith(MemberDirectPhone,'"+LEFT({!FormattedPhone_NumbersOnly_RemoveCountryCode},10)+"'))"

formulas.name: MemberFilterFormula_NoPhone
formulas.expression: "MemberEmail eq '"+{!$Record.Email}+"'"

formulas.name: MemberFilterFormula_PartialPhoneMatch
formulas.expression: "(MemberFullName eq '"+SUBSTITUTE({!$Record.FirstName}, "'", "''")+" "+SUBSTITUTE({!$Record.LastName}, "'", "''")+"' and startswith(MemberDirectPhone,'"+LEFT({!FormattedPhone_NumbersOnly_RemoveCountryCode},3)+"'))"

formulas.name: Office_FilterFormula
formulas.expression: "OfficeKey eq '"+{!APIOfficeKey}+"'"

formulas.name: OfficeListingCount_WithCap
formulas.expression: IF({!APIOfficeListingCountLast12Months}>=100000,99999,{!APIOfficeListingCountLast12Months})

formulas.name: OfficeListingCountLast12Months_FilterFormula
formulas.expression: "(ListOfficeKey eq '"+{!APIOfficeKey}+"' or BuyerOfficeKey eq '"+{!APIOfficeKey}+"') and ((OnMarketDate ge "+ TEXT(ADDMONTHS(DATEVALUE({!$Record.CreatedDate}),-12)) + " and OnMarketDate le " +{!LeadCreatedDate} +") or (ListingContractDate ge " + TEXT(ADDMONTHS(DATEVALUE({!$Record.CreatedDate}),-12)) +" or ListingContractDate le " + {!LeadCreatedDate} +")) and org.reso.metadata.enums.PropertyType ne 'Residential Lease' and org.reso.metadata.enums.PropertyType ne 'Commercial Lease'"

formulas.name: OfficeNameTrimmed_Formula
formulas.expression: LEFT({!APIOfficeName},50)

formulas.name: PhoneNumber_NumbersOnly
formulas.expression: IF(OR(CONTAINS({!$Record.Phone},"-"),CONTAINS({!$Record.Phone},"(")),SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE({!$Record.Phone},"-",""),"(",""),")","")," ",""),{!$Record.Phone})

formulas.name: TransactionCountLast12Months_FilterFormula
formulas.expression: "(BuyerAgentKey eq '"+{!APIMemberKey}+"' or ListAgentKey eq '"+{!APIMemberKey}+"' or CoListAgentKey eq '"+{!APIMemberKey}+"' or CoBuyerAgentKey eq '"+{!APIMemberKey}+"') and StandardStatus eq 'Closed' and DerivedCloseDate ge " + TEXT(ADDMONTHS(DATEVALUE({!$Record.CreatedDate}),-12)) + " and DerivedCloseDate le " + {!LeadCreatedDate} + " and org.reso.metadata.enums.PropertyType ne 'Residential Lease' and org.reso.metadata.enums.PropertyType ne 'Commercial Lease'"

formulas.name: TransactionCountLast6Months_FilterFormula
formulas.expression: "(BuyerAgentKey eq '"+{!APIMemberKey}+"' or ListAgentKey eq '"+{!APIMemberKey}+"' or CoListAgentKey eq '"+{!APIMemberKey}+"' or CoBuyerAgentKey eq '"+{!APIMemberKey}+"') and StandardStatus eq 'Closed' and DerivedCloseDate ge " + TEXT(ADDMONTHS(DATEVALUE({!$Record.CreatedDate}),-6)) + " and DerivedCloseDate le " + {!LeadCreatedDate} + " and org.reso.metadata.enums.PropertyType ne 'Residential Lease' and org.reso.metadata.enums.PropertyType ne 'Commercial Lease'"
